openings.claim: Bind retained video/caption revisions immutably through request, rendering and displayed identity. Optionally coalesce pending requests to the intended manifest; only matching completions become current. Identify other completions in history; pin delivered preview, manifest and original wording.
openings.discriminator: Manifests prevent source drift and identify pairs; coalescing reduces redundant pending work; publication matching prevents obsolete completions becoming current. Compare these separately and together.
openings.fit: Private accounts, embedded-caption renderer and delivered-version access preserved; four engineer-days, one editor-day and processing fit unverified.
openings.probe: Compare baseline, manifests only, coalescing only and combination in private staging with fabricated footage, burst edits, cut switches and reversed completions. Check hashes, wording, editor identification, render counts, elapsed time, retained delivery and effort.
openings.uncertainty: Immutable retention and conditional publication feasibility, label comprehension and savings unknown. Coalescing helps only pending work; running renders need not cancel.

openings.claim: Determine whether delay occurs before intended-artifact availability or during selection and viewing.
openings.discriminator: Late availability favors scheduling remedies; early availability followed by delay favors identification/review remedies.
openings.fit: Private demonstrations assumed to fit editor-day.
openings.probe: Align render timestamps with intended tuples; time availability, selection and viewing separately.
openings.uncertainty: Demonstrations discriminate causes but cannot establish 30-session acceptance.

lineage.reason: Identity mechanism retained as standalone comparator.
Pending coalescing, conditional publication and delivered-version pin retained.

decision: Probe causes and feasibility first; single-correction success limits replacement claims. If feasible, verify 27/30 within 15 minutes and zero unintended pairs; stop at 80 processing hours/week. Festival demand remains unknown.
